name: Gilbert Mill
source: All City King, former leader of the Hellhound Crew and a member of the Great Duo. Founded the crew to protest and inform citizens of the crimes of the authorities. Killed by police four years ago.
translation: All City King, former leader of the Hellhound Crew and a member of the Great Duo. Founded the crew to protest and inform citizens of the crimes of the authorities. Killed by police four years ago.
